newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Shell up, Mitsubishi Oil down in early Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Showa Shell up, Mitsubishi Oil down in early Tokyo.

text.p: Shares of Showa Shell Sekiyu KK rose in early morning trade on Monday, while those of Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd fell, following news that the firms were considering merging their refining operations.
As of 0019 GMT, Showa Shell was up six yen at 836 yen in volume of 55,000 shares.
Mitsubishi Oil was down eight yen at 515 yen in volume of 232,000.
Mitsubishi said in a statement on Sunday it was considering merging its oil refining division with that of Showa Shell.
A Showa Shell spokesman said on Monday that the firm was considering a merger of divisions as a way to cut costs.
However, neither company said when a final decision would be reached.
The move, if carried out, would launch what would be Japan"s biggest oil refining company, which is currently Nippon Oil Co Ltd.
